diffPanel.blockPreviewNote: The center text area shows a paragraph patch diff. The original stays in a light-red block and the revision drops into a light-green block at the same spot, so you can judge whether to adopt it in reading order.
diffPanel.errorFallback: Candidate generation failed. Please try again.
diffPanel.idle.hint: The result panel on the right stays pinned. Select a passage in the text first, then use the floating toolbar to start polish, expand, compress, strengthen emotion, strengthen conflict, or a custom instruction.
diffPanel.idle.waitingBody: After you start a revision, 2 to 3 candidates, a revision summary, and a paragraph diff appear here.
diffPanel.inlinePreviewNote: The center text area shows a detail-mark diff, good for confirming exact edits; if you would rather read the novel straight through, switch back to Paragraph diff.
diffPanel.loadingBody: Generating 2 to 3 candidates from the selected text. Please wait.
diffPanel.status.idle: Select text to start a local AI revision
diffPanel.title: AI revision results
director.candidateFailed: Candidate generation failed. Please try again.
director.handleThisCard: Handle this issue card with AI
director.loadingCandidates: AI is combining the chapter's macro positioning with your requests to generate 2 to 3 candidates.
director.noRecommendedTask: AI has not generated a recommended task yet. You can tell AI your revision ideas directly.
director.organizingBody: Analyzing this chapter's position in the volume, priority fixes, and directly actionable fragments. You can wait a few seconds before starting.
director.organizingTitle: AI is reviewing the current chapter
director.placeholder.chapter: For example: make this whole chapter feel more oppressive, but keep the plot facts unchanged and align it more closely with the volume's rising-pressure phase.
director.placeholder.selection: For example: make this passage feel more oppressive, but keep the plot facts unchanged and tighten the pacing.
director.scopeHint.chapter: Whole-chapter mode generates candidates from the entire chapter; you still need to compare before accepting.
director.scopeHint.selection: Fragment mode prefers the text you manually select; if nothing is selected, it uses the fragment located by the current issue card.
director.status.analyzing: AI is analyzing this chapter's macro positioning and priority fixes.
director.status.idle: AI first considers this chapter's position within the volume, then decides how to revise.
director.title: AI revision director panel
editor.helper.block: Now showing a paragraph patch diff; the original and the revision sit side by side as red and green blocks at their original position.
editor.helper.editable: You can edit the text directly; select content to start an AI revision.
editor.helper.inline: Now showing a detail-mark diff, good for confirming exact edits.
editor.helper.loading: AI is generating candidates from the selected content; the original position stays in place.
editor.helper.readonly: There is a pending candidate, so the text is locked for now; switch candidates or accept/reject on the right.
shell.aiRevisionFailed: AI revision failed. Please try again.
shell.candidateApplied: Candidate applied, and a snapshot before the AI edit was created.
shell.label.chapterFreeform: Generating a whole-chapter natural-language revision plan
shell.label.selectionFreeform: Revising the fragment per your instructions
shell.noAiResult: AI returned no revision result. Please try again.
shell.noCandidateToApply: There is no candidate to apply.
shell.selectChapterPrompt: Select a chapter to start editing the text.
shell.selectFragmentFirst: Select a text fragment first, or locate the matching fragment from an issue card.
shell.target.manualSelection: The text fragment you manually selected
sidebar.issueCardsEmpty: AI has not organized clear issue cards yet. You can enter revision notes on the right, or manually select a fragment to start a revision.
sidebar.issueCardsError: Issue cards failed to load for now. You can enter revision notes on the right, or manually select a fragment to start a revision.
sidebar.issueLoadingBody: AI is organizing priority fixes by chapter issues, volume position, and pacing goals. Please wait.
sidebar.macroError: Macro positioning failed to load for now. You can still edit the text or start an AI revision on the right.
sidebar.macroLoadingBody: AI is analyzing this chapter's position in the volume, pacing suggestions, and chapter tasks.
sidebar.macroPositionTitle: This chapter's position in the volume
sidebar.macroPreparing: Preparing this chapter's in-volume positioning and pacing suggestions.
toolbar.customPlaceholder: For example: make this passage feel more oppressive, keep the original information, but tighten the pacing.
